mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS above 4.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 4.5% and PAYEMS growth accelerates (> 200k new jobs per month), a tightening labor market fuels wage pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to anticipated inflation.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 2-month decline in INDPRO, indicating weakening supply chain dynamics, precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced productivity.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of instances with declining INDPRO, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.02 over any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always, HOUST serves as a leading indicator for consumer demand; when it exceeds 1200k units, S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 60 trading days due to broadening economic activity.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window, or SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances with HOUST above 1200k.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL growth exceeds 3% YoY, signaling rising inflation expectations, and FEDFUNDS is below 3%, investors anticipate monetary policy adjustments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always, UNRATE below 5% indicates a strong labor market, which consistently leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to increased consumer spending.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window, or SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 45% of instances with UNRATE below 5%.
